lifetime_architecture_disposition.name: Shared Set lifetime and current-root ownership architecture
lifetime_architecture_disposition.root_cause: Shared ordinary/native final Set cleanup clears mutable backing. Partial Snapshot/Refresh repairs leave other borrowed-state readers and publishers outside the same lifetime protocol.
lifetime_architecture_disposition.publisher_rule: Inventory every state.Store publisher. Publishers obey rootReuse before db.mu, except proven initial or offline exclusion.
lifetime_architecture_disposition.consumer_rule: Inventory every state.ValueLogSet consumer across lock release. Acquire the exact Set under publication exclusion before unlocking and retain it through the last consumer. Do not pin speculatively after unlock or weaken final alias scrub.
lifetime_architecture_disposition.current_root_rule: Topology-only DBState copies preserve the same primaryRoot current ownership edge without adding or withdrawing ownership.
lifetime_architecture_disposition.borrowed_state_rule: DB.State remains shallow borrowed metadata. Pointer-bearing readers require a live Snapshot or protected capture; convert internal db.State tree readers.
lifetime_architecture_disposition.exceptions: Live Snapshot-backed readers, explicitly retained offline Sets under exclusive ownership, initial unpublished states, and scalar-only basis checks are distinct safe cases when their stated exclusions hold.
